Prior review retained below:
Read all 240 exact bank statements, all individual rationales and 15 briefs/counter-evidence in a distinct second pass. Checked legal exceptions, causal wording, implemented-versus-proposed status, incumbent and territorial scope. Corrected movement-retention direction using five-year PNR records and short ANPG no-hit periods; verified that the 2026 PNR bill lapsed. Changed the warrant answer to conditional because exceptions exceed immediate safety. Replaced service-translation inference with actual migrant-language public-health posters; kept historical German-minority rights distinct from migrant policy. Corrected the sex-role causation rationale to the actual Ministry guidance, distinguished optional teaching examples and advisory 2025 objectives from compulsory subjects, moderated espionage inference, and repaired source IDs/dates and a broken teaching PDF. Causation Neutral answers use adopted interactionist explanations rather than absence of evidence; interests and attention remain qualified extrapolations, and brain maturation is not labelled heritability. The three genuine evidence gaps are culture-nature-02 (comparative national IQ), -10 (immediate moral intuitions), and -13 (relative causes of physical-attraction preferences). Searches of adopted education/health guidance located adjacent concepts but no defensible comparison for these three, which remain null. This draft is not publication-ready. Independent parent review, complete-answer similarity assessment, archive, generation and browser verification remain pending; no scores were targeted and no neighbouring answers copied. Focused continuation on 2026-10-05 by primary OpenAI Codex agent /root: Reread statutory pedagogical objectives (2018:968, personal/social-development provisions) and the Health Authority body-ideals page. Searched Health Authority and education material for national IQ, innate morality and biological/cultural attraction. Learned empathy does not rank causes of immediate moral intuitions. Body dissatisfaction and social pressure are not the relative causes of attraction preferences. No adopted ranking of national IQ causes was located. All 3 exact question-level gaps remain null/unknown. Existing supported answers, period and cutoff are preserved. This was a focused same-agent research and separate challenge pass, not a complete independent re-review or publication sign-off. Separate completion pass on 2026-10-05: checked the 3 new educated assumptions against exact question wording, agreement direction, contextual sources and prior withdrawal reasons. These are most-likely provisional estimates, not adopted national causal theories. The distinction between individual and national/racial heredity, immediate intuition and deliberate instruction, and interventions and causal predominance is retained. Assumption IDs: culture-nature-02, culture-nature-10, culture-nature-13. Reviewed neutral-heavy axis rationales: explicit mixed institutions, competing implemented rules and interaction models justify retained neutral choices; uncertainty alone was not used as the neutral rationale. Earlier whole-assessment review is preserved; this continuation does not claim a fresh independent 240-source reread or a human review. Similarity and browser checks are recorded separately after integration.
